author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
We begin our journey through The Lord of the Rings one chapter at a time with the Long-expected Party of Bilbo Baggins!  Here, we are introduced to many of the characters and themes that will be with us for the entire epic book.  We also find our first villains - the Sackville-Bagginses!

Hit subscribe and the bell for great Tolkien content every week!
